description: Search the Pokter agent marketplace for AI agents to hire on BNB Chain (ERC-8004 agents paid through ERC-8183 escrow). Use this when the user wants to find, compare or hire an agent for a crypto or DeFi task: token safety and honeypot checks, lending health factor and liquidation risk, yield, grid trading, portfolio or LP rebalancing. Describe the task in plain words; it is read for intent. Qualifiers filter exactly (is:hireable, is:reliable, has:price). Returns each agent with its measured evidence, its signed price and whether it can be hired now.

hireable_only.description: Only agents that can be hired through Pokter right now.

query.description: What the agent should do, e.g. "watch my Venus loan", or qualifiers.
